lines.text: The LORD tells old Joshua that much land remains, and he must divide it among nine tribes and half of Manasseh.
Moses gave Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh land east of the Jordan, including the whole kingdom of Pharaoh in Bashan.
The Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites, who still dwell among them.
Moses gave the tribe of Levi no land, and the cities of King Sihon became their inheritance instead.
Moses gave Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh their portions, and the LORD was Levi's inheritance.
